title: Agents
summary: Use the agent and sandbox infrastructure that is present in the Velclaw source tree.

sections.heading: Agent infrastructure exists
body: The repository contains sandbox agent implementations under lib/sandbox/agents and related workspace tooling. The source tree also contains agent-facing UI and configuration surfaces.

sections.heading: Define a clear role
body: Describe the goal, available tools, relevant project context, and expected output before an agent begins work.

sections.heading: Supply useful context
body: Connect agent work to the relevant project files and constraints rather than relying on an isolated prompt.

sections.heading: Review outputs
body: Treat agent output as normal engineering work: inspect the change, run validation, review the diff, and approve only when the result meets the project gate.
